Enum Filter

Namespace
SharpValhalla.Enums
Assembly
SharpValhalla.dll

Represents all available filter keys that can be applied when working with Valhalla routing and map-matching data.

Each case corresponds to a specific field in the Valhalla API, grouped by category (edge, node, admin, matched, etc.). The raw value matches the exact key string expected by Valhalla.

EdgeWeightedGrade = 32

The weighted grade factor. Valhalla manufactures a weighted_grade from elevation data. It is a measure used for hill avoidance in routing - sort of a relative energy use along an edge. But since an edge in Valhalla can possibly go up and down over several hills it might not equate to what most folks think of as grade.
